Location: Japan (UTC+9) Remote: Yes — worldwide, fully remote Willing to relocate: No Technologies: Linux, Kubernetes (AKS/GKE/EKS), Terraform, AWS, GCP, Azure, Python, CI/CD, REST APIs, Oracle/SQL Résumé/CV: Available on request Email: takutakutakkun0420@gmail.com

SEEKING FREELANCE / CONTRACT — SRE / Cloud Infrastructure — 10–20 hours/week

My focus is production reliability, particularly issues that involve multiple layers: Kubernetes workloads, cloud infrastructure, application logs, APIs, and databases.

My background includes production SRE and L3 technical investigations at an enterprise software vendor, plus previous Google Cloud Infrastructure and Data/AI support.

Selected freelance work:

- Completed a 225-hour Operations/SRE engagement with 5.0 client feedback. - Completed a private AWS Bedrock AI infrastructure engagement involving VPC, PrivateLink, and RAG, also with 5.0 feedback. - Earned $80K+ on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score and 1,400+ total tracked freelance hours across different engagements.

I’m interested in:

- Production incident investigation and documented root-cause analysis - Kubernetes, Terraform, and cloud infrastructure reviews - Deployment reliability, monitoring, and operational improvements - Private AI infrastructure and cloud/API integration

A good starting point is a small paid diagnostic or clearly scoped implementation milestone, with documented findings, verification steps, and agreed deliverables. Longer-term part-time arrangements are welcome.

I work remotely from Japan, prefer written/asynchronous collaboration, and can arrange limited overlap with US Pacific afternoons. Japanese and English. No overnight on-call.

If your team has a concrete infrastructure or reliability problem, I’d be glad to hear about the stack, scope, timeline, and budget.
